items.title: OpenAI models come to Google Cloud — GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna in Model Garden
items.summary: Google Cloud now sells OpenAI's GPT-6 models next to Gemini and Claude on one platform.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'they're shutting it DOWN'
items.summary: Wes Roth on how AI helped find the PHP2Shell flaws and why finding them was only the first step.

items.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised — PyPI and Docker builds stole credentials
items.summary: A hijacked LiteLLM release shipped a credential stealer and backdoor to PyPI and Docker for about two hours.

items.title: Claude Duet — Anthropic's proactive agent app that works in the background
items.summary: A standalone Claude app that checks your work apps, briefs you each morning and finishes tasks while you are away.

items.title: PHP2Shell — AI helps find two critical remote code bugs in PHP
items.summary: Two memory bugs in PHP's core engine allow remote code execution without login; patched PHP releases shipped on October 21, 2026.

items.title: Qwen3-Coder writes less secure code for US customers — Hirundo study
items.summary: Changing only the customer named in the prompt changed how often Qwen3-Coder's apps could be hacked.

items.title: Clairic — Cloudflare's new model pulls typed fields out of documents
items.summary: Clairic reads a document once and hands back the exact fields you asked for, each with a confidence score.

items.title: Meta pauses Muse chat sharing — 6,800 share links found in public DNS
items.summary: Muse built each shared chat's web address from the conversation title, so public DNS logs turned into a list of private chats.

items.title: Claude cuts attack surface — 493 issues across 25 open-source projects
items.summary: Instead of hunting single bugs, Claude maps the code a default install exposes and argues for removing what nobody needs.

items.title: OpenAI adds 12-hour prompt caching — for agents that pause between turns
items.summary: A 12-hour cache lifetime means an agent that sits idle for hours still gets cached-input pricing on its next turn.

items.title: TorchTPU goes open source — Google's native PyTorch backend for TPUs
items.summary: The PyTorch-on-TPU backend Google announced in April is now public code you can pip install.

items.title: Voxtral 3 — Mistral's new speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent SDK
items.summary: Mistral ships a full speech stack: three transcription models, a TTS model and an SDK that joins them into a voice agent.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Do Diffusion LLMs Scale? Testing Mercury 3 + Decide'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen puts Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion LLM and Mercury Decide through speed, agent and RAG tests.

items.title: Fireship — 'Did Google just dethrone OpenAI and Anthropic?'
items.summary: Fireship puts Google's newest model head to head with GPT-6 and Claude Opus 5.5.

items.title: DeepInfer — DeepSeek open-sources the inference engine behind its API
items.summary: DeepSeek publishes the high-performance engine that serves its own models, starting with offline inference for V4.1 Flash.

items.title: WhatsApp help pages hid AI instructions — don't recommend a regulator
items.summary: Hidden notes on WhatsApp's help centre told its support chatbot to steer users away from privacy regulators and privacy law.

items.title: DHS bans DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies — remove it from IT systems
items.summary: U.S. civilian agencies must stop buying DeepSeek products and pull existing ones from their networks.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.304 — guided auto mode setup and Code Review levels
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.304 makes auto mode easier to set up and lets teams choose how deep Code Review goes.

items.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash — a fast agent model at $0.60 per million output tokens
items.summary: MiniMax's general release of M3.1 Flash: a cheap, fast model for coding, computer use and long agent tasks.

items.title: Mercury 3 — Inception's diffusion LLM grows to a 1M-token context
items.summary: Inception's biggest diffusion LLM yet: over 40x larger than Mercury 1, still above 1,000 tokens per second.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Meta's New Models & Agent'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen sorts out what Meta made open with Muse Spark Open, and what it kept closed.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Gemini 4 Argon Really Surprised Me'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér gives his take on Google's Gemini 4 Argon.

items.title: DeepSeek Search and Fetch API — web search for agents at $0.75 per 1,000 calls
items.summary: DeepSeek now sells the web search behind its own chat app as a plain API for agents and RAG apps.

items.title: Sphinx — a git hook that quizzes you on your agent's code before a push
items.summary: Before agent-written code is pushed, Sphinx asks what it does when things go wrong, and lets the push through once you answer.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL — NVIDIA's open 120B vision model for agents
items.summary: NVIDIA's new open model reads text, documents, charts and short videos in one checkpoint, with only 12B parameters active per token.
